papers.title: GATE XL 2026 Predicted Paper 1
papers.description: Section P (Chemistry) + Section Q (Biochemistry) + Section R (Botany). Life sciences comprehensive.
papers.predictionRationale: Section P (Chemistry) Organic reaction mechanisms, Physical Chemistry thermodynamics/kinetics, and Inorganic coordination compounds. Section Q (Biochemistry) proteins, enzymes, metabolism. Section R (Botany) plant physiology, genetics. Comprehensive for P+Q+R combination students.
